STS2BALANCEMOD-SUNDIAL.title: Sundial
STS2BALANCEMOD-SUNDIAL.description: Every [blue]{Shuffles}[/blue] times you shuffle your [blue]Draw Pile[/blue], gain [blue]{Energy}[/blue].
STS2BALANCEMOD-SUNDIAL.flavor: "Early man's foolish obsession with time caused them to look to the sky for guidance, hoping for something permanent." - Zoroth
STS2BALANCEMOD-ORANGE_PILL.title: Orange Pill
STS2BALANCEMOD-ORANGE_PILL.description: Each turn, after you play a [gold]Power[/gold], an [gold]Attack[/gold], and a [gold]Skill[/gold], remove all negative effects from yourself.
STS2BALANCEMOD-ORANGE_PILL.flavor: "A pill made from all the fungi in the Spire. Cures everything!"
STS2BALANCEMOD-DEAD_BRANCH.title: Dead Branch
STS2BALANCEMOD-DEAD_BRANCH.description: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, add a random card into your hand.
STS2BALANCEMOD-DEAD_BRANCH.flavor: The branch of a tree from a forgotten era.
STS2BALANCEMOD-OMAMORI.title: Omamori
STS2BALANCEMOD-OMAMORI.description: Negate the next {Curses} [purple]Curses[/purple] you would obtain.
STS2BALANCEMOD-OMAMORI.flavor: A common charm for staving off vile spirits. This one seems to possess a spark of the divine.
STS2BALANCEMOD-SMILING_MASK.title: Smiling Mask
STS2BALANCEMOD-SMILING_MASK.description: The Merchant's card removal service now always costs [blue]50[/blue] Gold.
STS2BALANCEMOD-SMILING_MASK.flavor: Mask worn by the merchant. He must have spares...
STS2BALANCEMOD-COFFIE_CUP.title: Coffee Cup
STS2BALANCEMOD-COFFIE_CUP.description: You cannot rest at Rest Sites. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} additional Energy each turn.
STS2BALANCEMOD-COFFIE_CUP.flavor: The strong aroma keeps you wide awake, for better or worse.
STS2BALANCEMOD-FUSION_HAMMER.title: Fusion Hammer
STS2BALANCEMOD-FUSION_HAMMER.description: You can no longer Smith at Rest Sites. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} additional Energy each turn.
STS2BALANCEMOD-FUSION_HAMMER.flavor: Once held, it can never be put down.
STS2BALANCEMOD-CURSE_KEY.title: Curse Key
STS2BALANCEMOD-CURSE_KEY.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} additional Energy each turn. Whenever you open a [gold]Treasure Chest[/gold], obtain a random [purple]Curse[/purple].
STS2BALANCEMOD-CURSE_KEY.flavor: A key that opens doors to power, but each turn leaves behind a lingering curse.
STS2BALANCEMOD-PEACE_PIPE.title: Peace Pipe
STS2BALANCEMOD-PEACE_PIPE.description: You can now remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your deck at Rest Sites.
STS2BALANCEMOD-PEACE_PIPE.flavor: A quiet breath clears more than the lungs.
STS2BALANCEMOD-NECRONOMICON.title: Necronomicon
STS2BALANCEMOD-NECRONOMICON.description: On pickup, obtain [red]Necronomicurse[/red]. The first time you play an [gold]Attack[/gold] costing {Energy:energyIcons()} or more each turn, play it twice.
STS2BALANCEMOD-NECRONOMICON.flavor: Only a fool would try to command such evil power.
STS2BALANCEMOD-NILRYS_CODEX.title: Nilry's Codex
STS2BALANCEMOD-NILRYS_CODEX.description: At the end of each turn, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random cards to shuffle into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
STS2BALANCEMOD-NILRYS_CODEX.flavor: Compiled by the infamous game master himself.
STS2BALANCEMOD-ENCHIRIDION.title: Enchiridion
STS2BALANCEMOD-ENCHIRIDION.description: At the start of each combat, add a random [gold]Power[/gold] card to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
STS2BALANCEMOD-ENCHIRIDION.flavor: A legendary journal from an ancient lich.
STS2BALANCEMOD-MARK_OF_THE_BLOOM.title: Mark of the Bloom
STS2BALANCEMOD-MARK_OF_THE_BLOOM.flavor: In the deepest parts of the Spire, thought and reality are one.
STS2BALANCEMOD-MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.title: Mutagenic Strength
STS2BALANCEMOD-MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.descri: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] temporary [red]Strength[/red].
STS2BALANCEMOD-MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.flavor: Residual power from a genetic experiment.
STS2BALANCEMOD-DWARF_ANVIL.title: Dwarf Anvil
STS2BALANCEMOD-DWARF_ANVIL.description: On pickup, choose 3 cards. Each chosen card permanently costs 1 less {Energy:energyIcons()}.
STS2BALANCEMOD-DWARF_ANVIL.flavor: A compact anvil from deep within the Spire, radiating a faint blue heat.
STS2BALANCEMOD-WRIST_BLADE.title: Wrist Blade
STS2BALANCEMOD-WRIST_BLADE.description: Attacks that cost 0 deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] additional damage.
STS2BALANCEMOD-HOVERING_KITE.title: Hovering Kite
STS2BALANCEMOD-HOVERING_KITE.description: The first time you discard a card each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
STS2BALANCEMOD-HOVERING_KITE.flavor: The Kite floats around you in battle, propelled by a mysterious force.
